fact: The health ministry's digital health strategy, dated January 2023, states that management of clinical data and of the hospital information system is still at an experimental and local stage, that a WHO Africa survey found only a few pilot initiatives using electronic health records, that DEPSI leads digital health coordination, and that digital health interventions are financed essentially by partners, the State budget for it being minimal.
title: STRATEGIE NATIONALE DE SANTE DIGITALE DE MADAGASCAR 2023-2027
